name: Sim Wong Hoo
method: Muse Spark web search (2 calls) for leads; every fact below re-read from the cited page by the agent. corroborated = two or more independent sources.
gaps: The NLB Infopedia page only loads through Wayback (snapshot 2 Apr 2025). The 2026 family book and the ST article on it were not read directly; facts 5, 8 (giver), 13, 22, 24 and 48 come via VnExpress. The Peak republishes ST's '10 things', so the two are counted as one source.

facts.text: Born in 1955, the 10th child in a Zhao'an Hokkien family of five boys and seven girls.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)
Wikipedia: Sim Wong Hoo

facts.text: He grew up in a kampung in Bukit Panjang called End of Coconut Hill (Ye Shan Wei), where Fajar Road is today.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: His father, Sim Chye Thiam, worked as a factory labourer and later as a provision-shop attendant.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: His mother, Tan Siok Kee, reared chickens, ducks, pigs and rabbits, grew fruit and herbs, and sold eggs door to door.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)
Tatler Asia, 'Creative Technology founder and CEO Sim Wong Hoo dies' (Jan 2023)

facts.text: The family was so poor that several children shared beds of wooden planks laid on bricks; Sim later slept on two benches topped with a single plank.

sources.label: Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: Before school he sold eggs at the market; at home he cleared weeds, cut grass for the rabbits and prepared coconuts.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: Unable to afford toys, he made his own toys and board games; in his 1999 book he called himself a 'weird' child.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: He took up the harmonica at about 11 and regarded it as his first love; one account says a sister gave it to him.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: His father died in 1969, leaving his mother to raise the family alone.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)

facts.text: After Bukit Panjang Government High School he graduated from Ngee Ann Technical College (now Ngee Ann Polytechnic) in electrical and electronic engineering in 1975.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)
Wikipedia: Sim Wong Hoo

facts.text: At Ngee Ann he joined the harmonica troupe and arranged its scores; to accompany it he learned the accordion at playwright Kuo Pao Kun's Practice Theatre School.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: He only heard how his arrangements sounded at the troupe's weekly practice, so he dreamed of a computer synthesiser that would play them exactly as written.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: He later wrote that the village gave fertile ground for creativity and the harmonica club 'planted the first seed of Creative in me'.
facts.quote: The (Ngee Ann) Harmonica Club planted the first seed of Creative in me.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo, Chaotic Thoughts from the Old Millennium (1999), quoted by VnExpress

sources.label: Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: During National Service he tried a half-marathon with friends unprepared; he walked the second half and reached the finish after everyone had gone and the street was swept.
facts.quote: When I got to the end, there was nobody there. There was nothing left, even the street was cleaned up.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (TODAY, 2008)

sources.label: Ansley Ng, interview with Sim Wong Hoo, TODAY (June 2008), reposted on the nothingbutcreative blog

facts.text: He opened a computer tuition centre at Coronation Plaza with an acquaintance, who absconded with the tuition fees; Sim concluded he must be directly in control of any business.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: In July 1981 he opened a computer shop at Pearl's Centre in Chinatown with childhood friend and schoolmate Ng Kai Wa; this was the start of Creative Technology.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)
Wikipedia: Sim Wong Hoo

facts.text: The shop was 440 square feet and started on his savings of S$10,000; he taught computer classes to keep it going and, when business was poor, taught part-time at a private school.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Wikipedia: Sim Wong Hoo

facts.text: In the early days he lived on S$200 a month, he told Yahoo in 2019.
facts.quote: In the early days, I survived on $200 a month.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (Yahoo Finance, 2019)

sources.label: Janet Ong, 'Don't get married: Creative's Sim Wong Hoo advises budding entrepreneurs', Yahoo Finance Singapore (16 Apr 2019)

facts.text: In 1984 Creative launched the Cubic 99, the first PC designed and made in Singapore.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: The Cubic CT (1986), a multilingual multimedia PC, was not a commercial success; Sim turned to its sound technology instead. Accordion classmate Chay Kwong Soon joined as co-founder that year.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: The sound work became the Creative Music System (1987), renamed Game Blaster for the US market; Creative gave game developers free support and collected their wish lists.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: He moved to the US in 1988 and vowed not to return until he had sold 20,000 units; he reached the target.

sources.label: Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times
Wikipedia: Sim Wong Hoo

facts.text: Sound Blaster launched at Comdex in Las Vegas in November 1989 and took 600 orders at the show.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)

facts.text: According to the Wall Street Journal, cited by VnExpress, Michael Jackson turned up unannounced at the crowded Comdex booth and stayed nearly half an hour.

sources.label: Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: By the end of 1990 Sound Blaster was the world's top-selling PC add-on; revenue rose from US$5.4m (1989) to US$658m (1994).

sources.label: 'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)
Phong Ngo, 'From poor village boy to billionaire: Meet Sim Wong Hoo', VnExpress International (20 Aug 2026), citing the family book 'Sim Wong Hoo: The Light We Remember' via The Straits Times

facts.text: In August 1992 Creative became the first Singapore company to list on Nasdaq; Sound Blaster held 72% of the world market that year.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)

facts.text: He was named Businessman of the Year for 1992 (and again for 1997), the first person to win it twice; he wore a suit perhaps only for those two awards.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Grace Chng, 'Sim Wong Hoo: a simple, humble person who became Singapore's tech icon', Techgoondu (5 Jan 2023)
Wikipedia: Sim Wong Hoo

facts.text: In 1996 an oversupply of CD-ROM drives forced massive inventory write-downs; Sim refocused the company on audio, and the turnaround won him his second Businessman of the Year award.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)

facts.text: In February 1999 Goh Chok Tong opened the Creative Resources building at International Business Park; Sim put a childcare centre, an auditorium and a grand piano in its foyer.

sources.label: Grace Chng, 'Sim Wong Hoo: a simple, humble person who became Singapore's tech icon', Techgoondu (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: The Nomad MP3 player launched in 1999, about two years before Apple's iPod.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: In December 1999 he published 'Chaotic Thoughts from the Old Millennium', coining 'No U-Turn Syndrome': Singapore drivers U-turn only where a sign allows it.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)
Janet Ong, 'Don't get married: Creative's Sim Wong Hoo advises budding entrepreneurs', Yahoo Finance Singapore (16 Apr 2019)

facts.text: By 2000, aged 45, he was Singapore's youngest billionaire; SGX shares peaked at $64 in March 2000.

sources.label: Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)
Grace Chng, 'Sim Wong Hoo: a simple, humble person who became Singapore's tech icon', Techgoondu (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: He was stubborn: he rejected a white Zen in a white box and chose blue; soon after, Apple's white iPod took the world by storm. He also threw out a US$1 million Frog Design packaging concept.

sources.label: Grace Chng, 'Sim Wong Hoo: a simple, humble person who became Singapore's tech icon', Techgoondu (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: In August 2006 Apple paid Creative US$100 million for a licence to its Zen user-interface patent, ending five lawsuits.
facts.quote: We're very pleased to have reached an amicable settlement with Apple.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (Apple press release, 23 Aug 2006)

sources.label: Apple Newsroom, 'Apple & Creative Announce Broad Settlement Ending Legal Disputes Between the Companies' (23 Aug 2006)
Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: Creative still lost the MP3 war; it reported a S$187m full-year loss in August 2006 and turned to cost-cutting.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
Janet Ong, 'Don't get married: Creative's Sim Wong Hoo advises budding entrepreneurs', Yahoo Finance Singapore (16 Apr 2019)

facts.text: His mother died in 2006; the foundation he started that year was renamed the Sim-Tan Siok Kee Foundation in her memory.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)

facts.text: He gave more than S$49 million to charity in his lifetime, including S$30 million of Creative shares for two foundations, one honouring his mentor Kuo Pao Kun.

sources.label: Janice Loo, 'Sim Wong Hoo', Singapore Infopedia, National Library Board (read via Wayback snapshot of 2 Apr 2025)
'He took on Apple, Samsung: 10 things about Creative CEO Sim Wong Hoo', The Straits Times (Jan 2023)

facts.text: Creative voluntarily delisted from Nasdaq in 2007; its SGX shares later fell to around $1 by 2017.

sources.label: Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: He ran his first marathon in December 2007 in just under seven hours, then signed up for an 84 km ultramarathon.
facts.quote: I always do things when I am not prepared.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (TODAY, 2008)

sources.label: Ansley Ng, interview with Sim Wong Hoo, TODAY (June 2008), reposted on the nothingbutcreative blog

facts.text: He said he did his best thinking on the run and treated McWings as a post-run reward.
facts.quote: When I run, I am synchronised with the universe.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (TODAY, 2008)

sources.label: Ansley Ng, interview with Sim Wong Hoo, TODAY (June 2008), reposted on the nothingbutcreative blog

facts.text: By 2011 he was running from his home at Dairy Farm in Bukit Panjang to the office in Jurong; he wore a Casio watch, T-shirts and sneakers.

sources.label: Grace Chng, 'Sim Wong Hoo: a simple, humble person who became Singapore's tech icon', Techgoondu (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: He told Yahoo entrepreneurs shouldn't marry; a lifelong bachelor, he said having no family let him take risks.
facts.quote: I can take risks because I have no family.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (Yahoo Finance, 2019)

sources.label: Janet Ong, 'Don't get married: Creative's Sim Wong Hoo advises budding entrepreneurs', Yahoo Finance Singapore (16 Apr 2019)

facts.text: Super X-Fi, 20 years and over US$100 million in the making, launched in 2019; he started it because headphones fatigued him and he threw them away after five minutes.
facts.quote: I hated the sound of headphones because it made me fatigued after a while.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (CNBC, 2020)

sources.label: CNBC, transcript of Managing Asia interview with Sim Wong Hoo by Christine Tan (10 Apr 2020)

facts.text: Explaining how Creative survived: when he couldn't break through a wall, he looked for cracks and squeezed through.
facts.quote: So, I looked for cracks. So, there was a crack there, I squeezed through the crack and I managed it.
facts.speaker: Sim Wong Hoo (CNBC, 2020, quoted by ZDNET)

sources.label: Eileen Yu, 'Singapore tech pioneer behind Sound Blaster dies, marking end of illustrious era', ZDNET (Jan 2023)

facts.text: Employees remember him handing round a bag of hongbao of different amounts at Chinese New Year for staff to draw, and holding durian feasts.
facts.speaker: Leow Siew Kiat, former employee (ST, 2023)

sources.label: Prisca Ang, 'Creative Technology founder Sim Wong Hoo dies aged 67', The Straits Times (5 Jan 2023)

facts.text: He died suddenly on 4 January 2023, aged 67; the night before, he had a long discussion with his engineers and was due to meet the online sales team next day.

facts.quote: He was always bubbling with ideas. Never left a meeting with him without new inspirations.
facts.speaker: George Yeo (Facebook, Jan 2023)

sources.label: 'DPM Heng, Razer CEO among others pay tribute to late Creative CEO', Vulcan Post (Jan 2023)

facts.text: Kwok Kian Woon, who knew him for two decades, said: what others thought impossible, he would think possible.
facts.quote: What others thought would be well impossible, he would think it possible.
facts.speaker: Kwok Kian Woon (ST, 2023)
